register.reg_condition: when FEAT_ECV is implemented and FEAT_AA64 is implemented

purpose_text.para: Reads of CNTVCTSS_EL0 return the 64-bit physical count value minus a virtual offset.

configuration_text.para: All reads to the CNTVCTSS_EL0 occur in program order relative to reads to CNTVCT_EL0 or CNTVCTSS_EL0.

This register is a view of the CNTVCT_EL0 register for which reads appear to occur in program order relative to other instructions, without the need for any explicit synchronization. Reads of this register return a value consistent with the counter not being read until the read instruction is known to be non-speculative.

field_description.para: When EL2 is implemented, if the access is not trapped, and any of the following are true, then reads of CNTVCTSS_EL0 from EL0 and EL1 return (PhysicalCountInt<63:0> - CNTVOFF_EL2<63:0>):

listitem.content: All of the following are true: The Effective value of HCR_EL2.{E2H, TGE} is not {1, 1}. CNTVCTSS_EL0 is read from EL0.
All of the following are true: The Effective value of HCR_EL2.E2H is 0. CNTVCTSS_EL0 is read from EL2.
CNTVCTSS_EL0 is read from EL1 or EL3.

field_description.para: Otherwise reads of CNTVCTSS_EL0 return PhysicalCountInt<63:0>.
PhysicalCountInt is defined by 'The Physical Counter'.
